summary: hashicorp.vault.kv2_secret does create, update and delete for KV2, replacing vault_kv2_write and vault_kv2_delete. Parameters: auth_method (token/approle), cas, data (required), engine_mount_point (default secret), namespace (default admin), path (required), url (required, alias vault_address), versions, and state (present/absent, default present).
questions: Which module replaces vault_kv2_write and vault_kv2_delete?
What is the default Vault namespace in hashicorp.vault?
